text:
katie: Heads-up — DriftWatch just flagged an interop regression in staging after the SDK auto-unpin (2.7 -> 2.8) that we scheduled against runtime 3.1. Several long-context model runs return 503s. :eyes:

deploybot: [DriftWatch] ALERT: staging.r3.1 - model-group xg-qa - error rate 8.6% (baseline 0.2%) - sample log attached. Severity: P2.

mike: can you paste the failing stack or the request id?

katie: sure — sample request id: rq_20260321_3a9f

katie: log snippet:
```
2026-03-21T14:02:12Z ERROR inference.gateway.handler request_id=rq_20260321_3a9f status=503 upstream_error="kvcache-mismatch: kv_cache.get failed" model=llama3q-seq-long ctx_len=8192
trace: runtime/kv_cache.cc:87 mismatch expected 0x7f8a got 0x2b1
```

raul: looks like KV cache header serialization changed in runtime 3.1.x when used with SDK 2.8. We saw similar in early quant tests but thought the shim handled it.

eden: @raul do you think a soft-pin to runtime 3.0 for that model-group is safest while we triage? We can keep other models on 3.1.

raul: yes — do a model-group scoped pin. I'll open a rollback task to revert the runtime for xg-qa to 3.0 and run 1000 quick-run canary.

mike: +1. Also add a compatibility note to the release docs that SDK 2.8 requires runtime 3.1+ only after kvcache header migration flag is enabled. We should avoid a silent auto-unpin like this in the future.

katie: agree. I'll update the release checklist entry: add gated telemetry flag and preflight kvcache-only canaries.

deploybot: action created: RB-4521 rollback runtime for model-group xg-qa -> target runtime v3.0. Canaries scheduled: 3 runs immediate, 1k overnight. Link: https://go/rolls/RB-4521

raul: running quick check now: `scripts/canary_run --model xg-qa --runtime 3.0 --count 3`

raul: quick runs passed locally; staging canary 3/3 green so far.

eden: awesome. katie, can you update the release notes blurb? Something like: "SDK 2.8: KV-cache header format requires runtime 3.1+ with migration flag; if using auto-unpin, ensure model-group has migration toggle enabled or pin to 3.0 until migration completes."

katie: will do. Also adding an ops play: auto-unpin must not be applied to model-groups with long-context flag enabled without explicit owners opt-in.

mike: follow-up: should we pause auto-unpin job for 12 hours cluster-wide while we sweep model-groups for long-context usage?

eden: yes pause for 6-12h. I'll put up a short maintenance window and notify CS.

deploybot: job: auto-unpin-scheduler paused by eden at 2026-03-21T14:12Z — maintenance window open until 2026-03-21T20:00Z.

katie: thanks all. Raul — after rollback/green canary, please coordinate with release to re-run the migration flag rollout and then we can re-run unpin for consenting groups only.

raul: on it. I'll post results to this thread when the 1k overnight canary finishes. :thumbsup:

mike: great triage, short-term pin + docs + pause looks good.

katie: closing loop: ticket RB-4521 updated with post-mortem notes and release-docs PR link.

deploybot: RB-4521 status=IN_PROGRESS assignees=[raul]

katie: thanks, everyone.
